prompt: Use the attached locked V9 Companion inner-face sheet as the only character identity reference. Generate a new supplemental 3 rows by 4 columns contact sheet of exactly 12 equally spaced source poses for component extraction; this is an extension candidate, never a replacement for the attached V9 source. Pure white background, crisp filled black upright oval eyes, matched eye size and horizontal baseline, one dominant white primary reflection and a small static V9-like diamond identity sparkle, short paired rounded brows, tiny button nose, delicate petite mouth, cheek dots, generous whitespace, no labels or device frame. Keep the same sweet front-facing Companion identity. Every non-sleep pose must change eyes, paired brows, mouth and cheeks together enough to remain distinct at a 100 px thumbnail. Row 1 is daily attention left, right, up, down: make the four directions clearly distinguishable through deliberate primary-reflection placement and coordinated brow/mouth/cheek response, not only a one-pixel shift, while keeping eye bodies upright and matched. Row 2 is curious question, affectionate delight with a small heart, joyful sparkle, and alert surprised response with a restrained exclamation. Row 3 is focused recording with a record dot, listening focus with small sound arcs, menu thinking with ellipsis, and peaceful sleep with closed eyes and a soft resting mouth. The sleep cell must have no moon, no crescent and no Z mark. Charms stay detached in whitespace and never substitute for facial emotion. No cat outline, ears, whiskers, human styling, lashes, eyelid arcs touching eyes, side-eye, smirk, flirtatious look, aggression, grey, shading, gradients, noisy texture, text, panels or full-body art. Do not create charging or error faces.
negative_constraints: do not alter or replace the locked V9 source sheet
no whole-face sprite sheet runtime claim
no lopsided or warped eye bodies
no label text in any cell

generated_output.rejection_reason: white-outline/ring and drooping eye constructions departed from locked V9 identity and read as strange or overly deep
